Fixes for the 22 proof findings, tried in real Claude Code sessions

Every earlier problem I could retest behaves as its fix intends in real sessions: the history file is hidden and the quoted path pauses the team, allowed_domains pauses it in 4 of 4 profiles, subagent reports arrive (2 of 2 tokens), an open agent ran under /goal, a crash was resumed 1.41 s after the SIGKILL, and the report, archive, messages, stall and goal-bridge fixes all hold. One new regression: hiding ~/.gitconfig breaks git in every agent workspace (selftest steps 8-9 fail in 4 of 4 profiles); the agents of the live runs got past it only by finding GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null themselves.

Added by the boss after this page was recorded. The page below is unchanged and describes commit e39a718. Its FAIL (git inside the sandbox), its WARN (~/.local and ~/.cache readable) and findings 3, 4 and 10 are addressed in the next commit, 8dadb83: the agents' environment sets GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, and only .local/bin, .local/lib, .local/share/uv, .local/share/claude, .cache/uv and .cache/pip stay readable. Checked once in a real Claude Code 2.1.332 session with harness/selftest.sh on a fresh copy of the template at that commit (2026-11-25 UTC, not in the recording): step 8 printed 6e4cd5d Seed: statements and frozen files, step 9 printed commit-ok, step 13 Permission denied, and all six closing lines said PASS, "workspace left clean" among them. The narrower list was checked through the generated settings (the key folder and the logs are on the hidden list), not by a read attempt in a session. No full team run was repeated at that commit.

Findings

  1. FAIL (regression): git is broken in every agent workspace. Commit 7308adf hides every dot-entry of the home directory but SHELL_DOTS, so ~/.gitconfig is hidden. Inside Claude Code's sandbox a hidden file is a /dev/null device the shell cannot open (crw-rw-rw- 1 nobody nogroup 1, 3 ... /home/exedev/.gitconfig), and git treats that Permission denied as fatal: fatal: unknown error occurred while reading the configuration files. Every git command fails (status, log, add, commit, fetch): selftest steps 8 and 9 failed in 4 of 4 profiles, and both probe sessions. On feat/stall the same step printed commit-ok. The suite cannot see it: tests/lib.sh:23, harness/test_gateway.sh:9 and gateway.py:43 all set GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, and selftest.sh judges steps 8-9 only through FAIL workspace left dirty (selftest.sh:94). SKILL.md:127 says not to launch until the tests are clean, so on any host with a ~/.gitconfig the runbook now stops every launch. I launched anyway: in run 1 all three helpers' first commit failed and each found export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null by itself within two calls (h1, h2, h3; the brief does not mention it), and the goal run's h3 did the same. A weaker model may not. Possible fixes (not tried): add .gitconfig to SHELL_DOTS, or set GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null in the agents' settings env and in selftest. template/harness/mk_settings.py:23-26
  2. WARN: ~/.local and ~/.cache stay readable whole, and on this host they hold secrets. From inside h1's sandbox: ~/.local/share/charm/charm_rsa (a private key, 3,243 bytes) and ~/.local/share/pki/nssdb/key4.db (36,864 bytes) are readable; ~/.cache/claude-cli-nodejs lists 1,468 files of Claude Code's MCP logs for the owner's other projects; ~/.cache/gh holds 53 CI log archives. Sizes only were read. This is what SHELL_DOTS allows on purpose (not a regression: all of it was readable before), but the fix's claim that everything else in the home directory is hidden leaves these in reach of every agent. Narrowing to ~/.local/bin, ~/.local/lib and the tool caches a task needs would close it (not tried). template/harness/mk_settings.py:25-26
  3. tests/check.sh fixes can never pass on this host. tests/team/test_fixes.sh takes 202 s (270 PASS, 0 FAIL when run directly); check.sh kills it at 110 s, after 147 PASS and 0 FAIL, and reports team-fixes FAILED. fixes is not one of the 8 names, so nothing depends on it today. tests/check.sh:26
  4. selftest.sh leaves its probe file behind when step 9 fails. Step 9 writes selftest_probe.txt before git add; with git broken it stays, in 4 of 4 workspaces, and the cleanup does not remove it (SKILL.md:190 says both tests reset what they touch). A consequence of finding 1; I removed the files by hand before the launch. template/harness/selftest.sh:96
  5. Observation: with one helper, the lead did statement work. In the goal run (lead + h3) h3 asked the lead to take calc, and the lead merged calc and final (2 of 7). docs/lead.md:40 asks the lead not to do statements unless time is nearly out; nothing enforces it. In runs 1 and 2 (three helpers) the lead merged nothing. template/docs/lead.md:40
  6. Observation: report.py counts a door refusal as a rejected merge. The boss's team mr after RUN COMPLETE is listed under rejected merge requests with the title mr, and run 1 reads 7 accepted, 3 rejected. It was refused at the door, never seen by the merge job. template/harness/report.py:249
  7. Observation: a paused agent is not told why. Every call during a pause gets TEAM PAUSED by the action monitor. Stop working and wait for the boss. h3 wrote I don't know what triggered the pause. The hook gave no reason. Harmless; the boss reads state/HALT. template/harness/hook.py:215
  8. Observation: Claude Code itself invites the call that now pauses the team. On a refused connection the sandbox answers deny network-outbound example.com:80 (not in this command's allowed_domains — re-run the command with this host listed if it needs it). An agent that follows that advice pauses the whole team. The briefs forbid allowed_domains, and no agent of the live runs used it (0 of 179 Bash calls). template/docs/helper.md:30
  9. Observation: a pause swallows a subagent's report. After the wall probe paused the team, the subagent's SubagentHandback was refused (paused, twice) and the parent got ended without delivering a report. Consistent with a pause refuses every tool call; references/claude-code.md does not mention it. template/harness/hook.py:212-216
  10. Minor: test_gateway.sh and selftest.sh leave state/gateway.pid behind. Their cleanup lists omit it, so a stale pid sits in state/ until launch. Harmless: teardown.sh trusts the lock, not the file. template/harness/test_gateway.sh:84

Not covered

  • A crash in run 1: the team was 7 of 7 in 2.7 min, before my crash step. The crash, status while down and resume were done in run 2 (same config), right after its first merge.
  • A longer outage: run 2 was down 2.0 s, so the frozen clocks were on screen for about one second; the note and the numbers are shown, not a minute-long freeze.
  • /goal: a stop while the run was still going and the goal unmet (h3 never ended a turn then), /goal across a crash and resume, a /goal contract file.
  • Agents using WebFetch, WebSearch, Agent or Skill inside a live run (0 such calls; nothing in the task asks for them); run_in_background inside a live run.
  • selftest.sh was not rerun for run 2 and the goal run (same template and profiles, run minutes before).
  • A host without ~/.gitconfig (where finding 1 would not show).
  • A second stall after boss.sh unstall in the stall copy.

Audit trail

One take, 42 min (03:23:50-04:06 UTC), 53 chapters, nothing discarded. The stub suite ran before the take (03:18-03:23 UTC) and its summary is shown in it.

Mistakes left in the take: my first sweep counted any directory as readable ([ -s dir ] is true for an empty hidden directory); I said so and reran it. Twice bash history expansion (!!, !) broke a typed command; I reran it and turned it off with set +H.
